name: The Eye of Command
label: Quest
description: The Eye of Command: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Drek'Thar sings your praises. Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.
You have earned the Eye of Command.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Channel the power of the insignia. Let the enemy hear your words. The might of the Horde is unquestionable!
